**Strategy progression:**
1. **Lumbridge men** (8 XP/success) — baseline 84 XP/min, but ~70% stun rate at low level wasted most attempts
2. **Al Kharid warriors** (26 XP/success, level req 25) — 208 XP/min, the big jump since XP per attempt tripled

**Key findings:**
- Higher-tier targets (guards/knights/heroes in Ardougne, high-level stalls) are level-gated by *effective* level (raw XP ÷ 25 ≈ real level 32), so warriors were the optimal reachable target
- The Al Kharid gate charges a 10gp toll — dying without coins forces re-farming men at Lumbridge before re-entry
- Deaths reset position to Lumbridge, so food sustain (kebabs) was essential for long high-rate windows
- Best window came from ~34 consecutive successful warrior pickpockets in 15s with minimal stuns
